Specifies that the function removes points from the Fit Line that are further than the distance specified in the Fit Distance Filter parameter.

Specifies the minimum defect size, in pixels (valid ranges are 0.001 to 3 times the image width of the In-Sight vision system; default = 3 pixels) . Continuous deviations from the line fit which are less than this value are not considered defects.

Specifies the maximum defect size, in pixels (valid ranges are 0.001 to 3 times the image width of the In-Sight vision system; default = 3 times) . Continuous deviations from the line fit which are greater than this value are not considered defects.

Specifies the maximum area defect, in pixels (valid range is from 0.000 to 1000000; default is 1000000) . An area greater than this value is not considered a defect.
Specifies whether or not to filter defects based on their position relative to the line fit.
Specifies how the detected defects will be sorted.
Specifies whether or not the function accounts for gaps in the found edge.
Specifies the minimum gap, in pixels (valid ranges are 0.001 to 3 times the image width of the In-Sight vision system; default = 3 pixels) . Gaps less than this value are not considered to be gaps.
Specifies the maximum gap, in pixels (valid ranges are 0.001 to 3 times the image width of the In-Sight vision system; default = 3 times) . Gaps greater than this value are not considered to be gaps.

Specifies the maximum displacement, in pixels (valid ranges are 1 to 3 times the image width of the In-Sight vision system; default = 3 times) , from the line fit to be considered a gap. This setting acts as a filter to remove edges which are detected but are not along the same line fit as the other detected edges. If this distance is more than the Max Displacement parameter value, it is considered a gap.
Specifies whether or not the function accounts for gaps detected at the beginning and end of the ROI.
Specifies how the detected gaps are sorted.
Specifies the Caliper displayed on the image (the Caliper is outlined in green). The default Caliper displayed is 0.

Specifies the amount of free space after cleaning up files, in a percentage value. The default is 50. Note : If the tool cannot delete enough files to reach the desired free space threshold, the function returns an error after deleting what it was able to delete.
